title: Senior Software Engineer
profile: Backend-focused engineer with production Spring Boot experience building audit-critical, referentially-strict systems, from RSA/JWT authorization to a financial computation engine gated by multi-stage approval and published downstream through Kafka. I also rewrote a multi-tenant SaaS backend from Kotlin to Rust (Actix Web, SeaORM) with live Paystack payments on the side. Comfortable owning correctness under concurrency and reasoning about consistency/throughput trade-offs in financially-sensitive systems.

education.institution: Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology
education.degree: BSc Computer Science with MTN Bright Scholarship Reloaded. First Class Honours

bullets: Architected and implemented a JWT RSA-based authentication and authorization system with SSO integration, custom @Authorization annotations, and role-based access control across six user roles.

Owned an automated financial computation engine (PI-period bonus/performance scoring) gated by a multi-stage approval lifecycle (staffing computation, finance sign-off, finalized, closed) before data is released downstream.

Built the Kafka event-publishing integration that syncs finalized bonus data to Amalitech's payroll system, restructuring the payload to match the payroll team's spec and coordinating directly with them on the contract.
Enforced data-integrity constraints via PostgreSQL triggers, resolved N+1 query issues via batch fetching, and maintained 70%+ test coverage (JaCoCo, Hurl E2E) with rate limiting (100 req/min/user).
Worked in a team of 4 to build a logging system for aggregating and analyzing logs across services (Spring Boot + React), supporting production incident investigation.

2.5+ years progressively owning backend systems for a health-tech platform: cloud storage, verification flows, PDF generation, real-time notifications (SSE, WebSocket), and an EMR migration from TSOA to NestJS/Prisma with zero data loss.

projects.name: Adzesua: Multi-Tenant School Management Platform
bullets: Rewrote a multi-tenant school-management backend from a legacy Kotlin/Ktor service to Rust (Actix Web, SeaORM, PostgreSQL with row-level security for tenant isolation): tenant onboarding, fee structures, and installment billing with Paystack webhook-verified payments.
Implemented per-tenant branding and Google OAuth2 authentication, with structured request-lifecycle logging to keep multi-tenant behavior observable and debuggable.

Built a VS Code/Neovim extension for managing Liquibase database migrations directly from the editor: sidebar changelog tree, live migration dashboard, and the full command set (update, rollback, diff, snapshot, generate), auto-detecting Maven, Gradle, or standalone CLI setups.
